origin.description: Sort under a temporary LC_COLLATE, then restore it.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Locale name, such as C or fr_FR.

origin.details: This sets the LC_COLLATE locale and the LC_COLLATE environment variable, then restores both.
origin.example:
x <- c("bernard", "boris", "béatrice", "bérénice")
before <- Sys.getlocale("LC_COLLATE")
out <- local({
  local_collate("C")
  sort(x)
})
c(out, if (identical(Sys.getlocale("LC_COLLATE"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Sort under a temporary LC_COLLATE, then restore it.

arguments.name: new
arguments.text: Locale name, such as C or fr_FR.

translation.details: This sets the LC_COLLATE locale and the LC_COLLATE environment variable, then restores both. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

import locale
x = ["bernard", "boris", "béatrice", "bérénice"]
before = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_COLLATE)
with local_collate("C"):
    out = sorted(x, key=locale.strxfrm)
after = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_COLLATE)
return out + ["restored" if after == before else "open"]
